cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(ui_fractional_font_check LANGUAGES CXX)
get_filename_component(BBLITE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
find_package(RmlUi CONFIG REQUIRED NO_DEFAULT_PATH
    PATHS "${BBLITE_RMLUI_DIR}/lib/cmake/RmlUi")
find_package(Freetype REQUIRED)
add_executable(ui_fractional_font_check
    "../ui-fractional-font-check.cpp" "${BBLITE_ROOT}/native/src/pal_system_fonts.cpp")
target_compile_features(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE
    "${BBLITE_ROOT}/native/include" "${BBLITE_ROOT}/native/src")
target_link_libraries(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE RmlUi::Core Freetype::Freetype)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE /W4 /WX /UNDEBUG)
    target_link_libraries(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE dwrite)
else()
    target_compile_options(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
    if(APPLE)
        find_library(CORE_TEXT CoreText REQUIRED)
        find_library(CORE_FOUNDATION CoreFoundation REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE "${CORE_TEXT}" "${CORE_FOUNDATION}")
    else()
        find_package(Fontconfig REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(ui_fractional_font_check PRIVATE Fontconfig::Fontconfig)
    endif()
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME ui_fractional_font COMMAND ui_fractional_font_check)
